p_valley: Gerbil Valley, before the billionaires came. Everybody had a little, and the fountain ran.
p_jar: Everybody put a little in the jar. The jar paid for the school, the road, and the fountain. That is what taxes are.
p_giants2: And each one went to a stall.
p_prices_trump: In our story, Trump made houses cost more.
p_jartake2: In our story, they took the jar's money too.
p3_prices_trump: In our story, Trump made things cost more. Your twenty dollars buys less now.
p3_market_go: Grow the market at the crate.
p3_market: This part is true: when the market grew, the richest gerbils got most of the new coins. Seven went up the hill. Three went down the street.
p3_fair_decide: You get to decide. Lots of grown-ups argue about it.
p3_news_bezos_1: This part is true: Jeff Bezos bought a newspaper.
p3_news_bezos_2: In our story, his paper said the jar was fine.
p3_news_fixed: Now the paper shows the real jar.
p3_jar_musk: This part is true. One year, Elon Musk put in zero dollars. The rules let him.
p3_story_bloomberg_1: This part is true. Michael Bloomberg spent a giant pile of his own money trying to be president, in just a few months.
p3_story_bloomberg_2: He won only one place: some little islands far out in the ocean.
p3_story_walton_1: This part is true. Rob Walton's dad started Walmart, and Rob was born into the family that owns it.
p3_story_walton_2: But some people who work in its stores need help from the jar to buy food.
p3_story_zuckerberg_1: This part is true. When new apps got popular, Mark Zuckerberg bought them.
p3_story_zuckerberg_2: He bought a photo app, and then a chat app, for giant piles of money.
p3_story_page_1: This part is true. Larry Page's company, Google, paid Apple a giant pile of money, so iPhones would use Google.
p3_story_page_2: A judge said Google is a monopoly. It has almost all the searching to itself.
p3_giants_story: Then, in our story, the billionaires came down the road.
p3_catchup: In our story, the billionaires took the money from the jar, and the street fell down.
p3_tag3_trump: In our story, Donald Trump took his money to the Golden Tower. Go get him!
p3_tag3_ellison: In our story, Larry Ellison took his money to the Data Harbor. Go get him!
p3_tag3_bezos: In our story, Jeff Bezos took his money to the Warehouse. Go get him!
p3_tag3_musk: In our story, Elon Musk took his money to the Rocket Yard. Go get him!
p3_tag3_bloomberg: In our story, Michael Bloomberg took his money to the Campaign Stage. Go get him!
p3_tag3_walton: In our story, Rob Walton and family took their money to the Superstore. Go get them!
p3_tag3_zuckerberg: In our story, Mark Zuckerberg took his money to the Giant Phone. Go get him!
p3_tag3_page: In our story, Larry Page took his money to the Search Tower. Go get him!
